title: The Suspicious Calculator
story: Finance is filing taxes using the office calculator.
The office calculator was 'improved' by Bob last week.
Finance would like to know, BEFORE filing, what it will say for 7 x 6.
Finance has asked very politely. Finance has a lawyer.
objective: Work out what Bob's calculator will answer for 7 * 6.

/opt/calculator/CHANGELOG.txt: - results are now rounded up 'for morale'
- added dark mode (the screen is broken)
/opt/calculator/manual.txt: Thank you for purchasing CALC-9000 PRO MAX.
It is a calculator. It calculates.
If it does not calculate correctly, please do not call us.

hints: Compare each result in history.log with what the answer should be.
Every single answer is wrong by exactly the same amount.
completion: Finance has switched to counting on their fingers.
